songs.title: 우산 쓰고 첨벙첨벙!
songs.style: jazzy rainy-day pop, 98 bpm, brushed drums, upright bass, finger snaps, splashing water sounds, playful clarinet, smooth female lead, toddler sing-along kids song, Korean lyrics, clear slow pronunciation, simple catchy melody with small note range, kids choir echoes the short shouts in brackets, major key

[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
우산 쓰고 첨벙첨벙 (첨벙!)

[Verse 4]
토롱 우산은 어디 있지?
큰 나무 아래 쏙 (쏙!)

[Chorus]
쿵쿵 쾅! 쿵쿵 쾅!
우산 쓰고 첨벙첨벙 (첨벙!)
